correctness.rationale: In Lebedev’s actual upper affine chart, (d+1) Hamming-separated cube corners have disjoint cut caps with threshold t=(dn−m)/2. Cube cap volume is 1/d! Σ(−1)^k binom(d,k)(t−kn)_+^d, so chart Jacobian 2^d directly gives the displayed exact full volume spline. At m_j=(d−2j)n only k=j branch changes; d-th right-minus-left derivative is (d+1)(−1)^{j+d}binom(d,j). For noninteger τ=(dn−m)/(2n), delete Hamming layers ≤r and replace each exposed r→r+1 cube edge with a simple cut vertex, yielding f0 formula (6). At integer τ=j the disjoint layer-j vertices number (d+1)binom(d,j); local tangent cone has d+1 facets and rays e_a (a in N), e_a+e_b (a in N,b in P), hence degree (j+1)(d−j). Every other vertex is simple; equality of jump magnitude and K_j follows. Independently checked exact d=7,11,15 resonances and sign/degree; no finite check substituted for universal disjointness proof.
